Small prop-trading firm | Senior Software Engineer | Onsite | Paris, France | Full-time | Competitive comp

Hi HN, we're a small (currently 7 people) proprietary trading firm focused on prediction markets & sports. If you love great software, sports, maths and want lots of ownership - come join us! Ideally, you have experience in software engineering for quant finance, but this isn't a hard filter.

Apply by emailing draftpicks[at]kairos-research.ai with a quick line on why this interests you and a CV/Github.
